basis: Biallelic RPE65 variants cause retinal degeneration; retinal disease belongs to ocular, not neurologic.
Developmental impairment and ocular anomalies define syndrome; kyphosis in 2/2 and hip subluxation in 1/2 support skeletal involvement, with a very small sample.
Intellectual disability, muscle hypoplasia/contractures and lung hypoplasia define syndrome; strabismus 80-99%. Dental anomalies and urethral hypospadias (30-79%) omitted under cap.
Diffuse glioma arises in midline central nervous system structures.
Psychotic disorders are explicitly outside the axes; psychiatric impairment alone does not establish neurologic organ damage.
Hexosaminidase A dysfunction causes GM2 storage and progressive neurodegeneration; functionally damaging ocular involvement is not established as common for the B1 variant.
Developmental delay and intellectual impairment characterize partial chromosome 19 duplications; other organ abnormalities vary by duplicated segment and lack group-wide frequency evidence.
Macrophage-mediated inflammatory lesions affect skeletal muscle and fascia; weakness is common. Fever, fatigue and arthralgia do not establish additional organ damage.
Hereditary skin hyperpigmentation; supplied phenotype establishes cutaneous disease without evidence of other organ involvement.
Autoimmune pulmonary disease defines lung and immune involvement; altered PBMC function does not itself indicate a blood-cell disease.
